intended_object: The "odd part" h_z(u) = (f_z(u) − f_{z̄}(u))/(2i) of the twisted pair, where f_z(u) = η(u)·e^{−2πiuz}. This is an auxiliary function from the source's Hilbert-space inequality (from the docstring and the module documentation).
explanation: The body is exactly (fz η z u − fz η (conj z) u)/(2i). The helper fz η z u = η(u)·exp(−2π i u z) matches its docstring. Division by 2i is never by zero, so no junk-value convention is involved. The file's lemmas (hz anti-invariant under conjugation, fz = gz + i·hz) hold for this definition, as the source requires. This is one specific function from the paper in its natural setting, not a general construction, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has nothing corresponding to it.
